benchmark.name: SEED Foundations
benchmark.reusePolicy: Structure and decision-guide quality were benchmarked; SEED text, product examples, and branded artwork were not copied.

visualVerdict.reasoning: The shared LDS renderer presents a mature editorial guide with compact navigation, numbered hierarchy, directly paired Do/Don't examples, and stronger governance traceability than the benchmark.

remainingDifferences: SEED uses branded product artwork and production examples; LDS deliberately uses robotics operations examples and live Storybook surfaces.
Some wide reference tables scroll within a keyboard-focusable region on narrow screens instead of collapsing their semantic columns.
